About the job

Five9 is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Campaign Management and Outbound. You will report to the Vice President of Product Marketing. The team of 8 owns the campaign platform and the outbound program. You need 8+ years of product marketing experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Marketo. Compensation is $180,000 per year. You will write the launch plan, brief the sales team of 12, and review campaign performance with the San Ramon office. The stack includes Salesforce, HubSpot, and Tableau. This role owns the outbound messaging for the contact-center product line and partners with the product managers who ship the dialer. You will set the quarterly narrative, keep the competitive tear-downs current, and join the weekly pipeline review.
